item.title: Euronews: Tokyo records longest rainy streak on record with 34 consecutive days
item.description: Tokyo has recorded 34 consecutive days of rain, marking the longest such streak on record, according to Japan's weather agency.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Dans les coulisses de la fin du macronisme
item.description: La droite et le centre apparaissent plus faibles que jamais au sortir des deux mandats d’Emmanuel Macron. Quelle responsabilité porte le président dans l’état de déliquescence de son propre camp ? Pauline Thiévenaud, journaliste à RTL, et Jérémy Marot, journaliste à l’AFP, ont mené 160 entretiens et racontent dans « Le crépuscule des princes », […]

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Burnham pledges to scrap pension triple lock from 2030
item.description: Major think tank warns change won't fund prime minister's social care plans.

item.title: Euronews: France's public debt soars to a record 119% of GDP
item.description: France's public debt reached 3,595.5 billion euros at the end of June, Insee said, a record high that is set to keep rising as the outlook worsens.

item.title: Euronews: IEA could consider more oil reserve releases as Europe faces tough winter
item.description: The IEA says it could consider releasing more emergency oil stocks if supply disruptions worsen, although another release is not currently its top priority. Europe faces a difficult winter after spending more than €100bn extra on energy imports since the Iran war began.

item.title: Euronews: Azerbaijan Tourism Board CEO: Baku-Brussels flights on the horizon for 2027
item.description: Azerbaijan is boosting connectivity with four-weekly flights between Baku and Brussels. But beyond the capital, Azerbaijan Tourism Board CEO Florian Sengstschmid told Euronews that visitors should discover the country’s hidden villages.

item.title: Euronews: Evicted 87-year-old Madrid pensioner can return home, says tenants union
item.description: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction fuelled protests over Spain’s housing crisis will be able to return to her Madrid home following an agreement with the property owner.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Budget : comment Matignon compte durcir l’accès des étrangers aux APL et allocations familiales
item.description: Si la mesure est adoptée, les étrangers devront justifier d’un an de résidence avant de toucher certaines prestations familiales.

item.title: Euronews: Spanish government unveils new measures aimed at easing housing crisis
item.description: The government has been facing growing pressure from a housing protest movement amid high costs and public outcry over the eviction of an 87-year-old woman.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Le Pen faces fallout after Bardella accused of antisemitic remarks
item.description: The National Rally president vigorously denies the allegations, which is rattling Le Pen’s presidential campaign.

item.title: Euronews: Pope's visit to France is 'beginning of a new mission to Europe', expert says
item.description: Austen Ivereigh, a fellow in Contemporary Church History at Oxford University, thinks one of the biggest themes of Pope Leo XIV's pontificate will be "to build a new world order", as he sees the old one "has crumbled".

item.title: Euronews: Middle East oil exports rise as LNG traffic through Hormuz picks up
item.description: Months into the war with Iran, Gulf exporters are finding ways to keep oil and gas moving, but crossing Hormuz remains risky and some customers are still missing contracted cargoes.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: UK must avoid US-style climate debate, minister says
item.description: The U.S. has been "undermined" by climate rows, Katie White argued.

item.title: Euronews: One in eight cancer cases worldwide is linked to preventable infections, study finds
item.description: Infections caused by viruses, bacterium and parasites caused an estimated 2.3 million new cancer cases in 2024, with low- and middle-income countries bearing most of the burden.

item.title: Euronews: Counterfeit medicine trade: how online pharmacies are selling deadly fake painkillers across Europe
item.description: Deadly synthetic opioids disguised as legitimate painkillers are being sold online across Europe, as counterfeit medicines linked to multiple deaths in the Netherlands expose the dark side of e-commerce.

item.title: Euronews: Masters of Uzbekistan: how traditional crafts are passed on to new generations
item.description: Traditional workshops in Uzbekistan are teaching younger generations the skills behind woodcarving, embroidery and ceramics, while adapting their work to contemporary tastes and new opportunities.

item.title: Euronews: Protesters march for unrestricted abortion access in Chile and Colombia
item.description: Demonstrators gathered in Santiago and Bogotá on International Safe Abortion Day, calling for greater access to abortion and defending reproductive rights.

item.title: Euronews: Italy's battery gold rush: Energy storage creates a new market
item.description: From paper projects to batteries now online: the energy market is changing and the value of storage is soaring worldwide

item.title: Euronews: Celine Dion surprises Paris Fashion Week with performance at L'Oréal show
item.description: Canadian singer Celine Dion made a surprise appearance at L'Oréal's fashion show in Paris, performing on stage with the Eiffel Tower in the background alongside a star-studded line-up of celebrities and models.

item.title: Euronews: Inflation in Spain surges to 4.9% in September on higher fuel prices
item.description: Inflation in Spain climbed 0.6% in September to 4.9%, driven by higher fuel prices, lubricants and package holidays. Core inflation rose 0.2% to 3.1%.

item.title: Euronews: ‘KEEP OU-’: Banksy’s powerful anti-Brexit installation to go up for sale
item.description: Titled “Keep Ou T” and currently displayed ahead of Phillips' Frieze Week Modern & Contemporary Art Auctions in London, the artwork dates from 2019 and goes under the hammer next month.

item.title: Euronews: Exclusive: EU-wide digital levy might generate up to €25bn annually for next budget
item.description: The European Parliament's proposed digital levy could raise up to €25bn a year for the next EU budget, five times the Commission's estimate, according to figures shared exclusively with Euronews by MEP Danuše Nerudová.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Scottish Labour leader says UK rejoining EU ‘not a realistic prospect’
item.description: Michael Marra said that current political conditions in Europe mean the bloc is not in a position to consider a British return.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Greater Manchester mayor Bev Craig vows to put ‘grown-up shoes’ on when hosting Donald Trump
item.description: Craig — fresh from meeting Zohran Mamdani — says she will host the U.S. president at the G20 next year "in a professional and serious way."

item.title: Euronews: European Travel Commission CEO: 'Climate change is the biggest threat to tourism right now'
item.description: While Europe remains the world’s tourism playground, Eduardo Santander of the European Travel Commission told Euronews that the continent needs to coordinate better to tackle climate challenges and congestion.

item.title: Euronews: Polo makes landfall in Mexico as Category 3 hurricane, cutting power and causing floods
item.description: This year's Pacific hurricane season is shaping up as more severe than usual, as a Super El Niño, an extreme version of a recurring weather pattern, wreaks devastation, in the form of historic droughts and flooding.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: Alan Milburn rejects tax cut for youth jobs
item.description: The U.K.'s young employment adviser says a national insurance cut would "not be an effective use of public money."

item.title: POLITICO Europe: French presidential hopeful Philippe proposes pushing retirement age to 65
item.description: The former PM is presenting himself as a responsible candidate unafraid to address hard truths.

item.title: Euronews: French students clash with police as blockades over conditions in schools intensify
item.description: Tens of thousands were expected to rally in Paris and other cities, with teachers and fire services striking nationwide although with public transport not badly affected.

item.title: Euronews: ‘Climate change is very much related to travel costs,’ says tourism chief
item.description: European Travel Commission CEO Eduardo Santander says rising travel costs, labour shortages and climate change are putting pressure on Europe’s tourism industry.

item.title: Euronews: Central Europe should be marketed as one destination, tourism leaders tell Euronews Travel & Tourism Summit
item.description: Hungarian and French tourism leaders say closer cross-border cooperation could create richer experiences for visitors, while better use of data and greater protection of nature are vital to the region’s future.

item.title: POLITICO Europe: UK’s global role in AI safety ‘not diminished’ by Trump, says AI minister
item.description: AI Minister Kanishka Narayan said he's not bothered if the U.S. gets "first dibs" on AI model testing.

item.title: Euronews: Euronews Travel & Tourism Summit: US envoy says Global Entry for Belgians could come by end of 2026
item.description: Bill White, Ambassador of the United States to Belgium, told Euronews that Belgian travellers could soon breeze through major US airports as Global Entry plans move forward.

item.title: Euronews: Trump's AI rebrand sparks unexpected rush for Slovenian .si domains
item.description: After Trump told the UN General Assembly that "artificial intelligence" sounded "fake" and the US would adopt "super intelligence" or SI, Slovenia's domain registrations jump from 3,500 a month to a whopping 3,700 a day.
